phenomenon: sparse class-by-direction grid with a rarely-filled optional slot and two-letter codes that only look composable
notes: The CLASS x DIRECTION grid is six train classes by two directions and seven of twelve cells are attested. The optional PRIORITY slot is filled by only two of those seven codes, so the deepest path rests on thin evidence and must still merge into one template rather than splitting off a second construction -- the mirror image of multi_construction_grid, where the optional slot is better attested. Two negatives. Yard codes are two-letter contractions of place names (Briar Notch, Cedar Vale) whose letters carry no reusable meaning, so they must be refused even though they form a tidy surface family. Track numerals are arbitrary siding identifiers, in a codebook where no other numeral is compositional either. Domain deliberately outside the device-repair setting the pipeline was developed on.

codebook.hot: expedited, runs ahead of same-class traffic
codebook.T1: track 1, the long siding at the north end
codebook.T2: track 2, the short siding by the tower
codebook.dbl: doubled over, train occupies two tracks
codebook.reX: recrew required at the next terminal
